summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of bilingual task management app (Phase 1: bilingual foundation, task header redesign with inline panels, unified sections). Tested auth page language toggle, task meta bar with inline panels, breadcrumb pickers, schedule/plan/tags panels, Notes page inline panels, and English/Persian mode switching.

✓ Onboarding dialog dismissal with 'رد کن' button
✓ Task meta bar displays correctly with all items (schedule, plan, priority, tags, pin)
✓ Meta items show icon only when unset, icon + value when set
✓ Priority inline panel opens with data-panel='priority' attribute
✓ Inline panel is NOT a floating popover (no Radix popper wrapper)
✓ Re-clicking same meta item closes the panel
✓ Escape key closes panel but does NOT close task drawer
✓ Choosing a priority option closes the panel automatically
✓ Avoidance switch in priority panel works and shows task-meta-avoidance item
✓ Only one panel visible at a time (opening tags closes schedule)
✓ Schedule panel has all three tabs (date, block, bucket)
✓ Schedule panel has postpone buttons (postpone-1, postpone-3, postpone-7)
✓ Breadcrumb folder picker opens inline panel (data-panel='folder')
✓ Breadcrumb goal picker opens inline panel (data-panel='goal')
✓ New folder button found in folder panel
✓ Tags panel has new tag button and tag create input
✓ Tag create input appears when clicking new tag button
✓ Persian digits and RTL layout work correctly
✓ Date formatting shows Persian dates (e.g., '۷ مهر ۱۰:۲۷')
